en: Have you heard? They're building a Safari Zone just past this cliff. You can catch any Pokémon you find there!
I can hardly wait. Hurry up and finish it, workmen!
The Safari Zone's open at last, just around the corner! Any Pokémon you find, you can catch. Won't you go and look?
That's the spirit! Up the stairs and out onto the cliff path. It's only a short walk from there.
Really? It's such a bargain, though...
You've been to the Safari Zone, haven't you? Don't tell me, I can see it on your face. It was wonderful!

Warden Baoba's Safari Zone
COMING SOON! Wild Pokémon to find around every corner!

Warden Baoba's Safari Zone
NOW OPEN! Wild Pokémon to find around every corner!
